messages:
Sam: quick sync — planning to enable ff_prefetch_batching_v2 for a 5% canary on prod tomorrow at 12:00pm PST. Need ops signoff + perf QA.
Jordan: what’s the rollback plan and which metrics should we gate on?
Anya: rollback is a single flag flip to OFF. fallback path already tested. primary guardrails: p95 latency delta, 5xx rate, and kv-cache mem growth.
Lee: @oncall can you be on standby 12:00–14:00 PST? we may need a fast rollback.
oncall: I can take that window. please @mention me when toggling.
Sam: suggested thresholds: 5xx spike > 0.5% OR p95 increase > 100ms relative to baseline OR node kv_cache_usage > 10GB for 3m -> immediate rollback.
Jordan: I’ll run a short perf sweep against canary nodes now (10k reqs over 10m) and post results.
Anya: config we'll use for canary in case folks need to QA quickly:
```json
{"flag":"ff_prefetch_batching_v2","audience":"canary-5pct","timeout_ms":1200,"batch_max_tokens":1024}
```
Sam: ops checklist before toggle: update runbook with memory guardrail, add alert for kv_cache_usage > 9GB (5m window), notify SRE, schedule toggle in console, and assign oncall.
ops-bot: created incident window: https://infra/maintenance/19321 — maintenance window 12:00–14:00 PST.
Jordan: perf run finished: baseline vs canary: p50 +3ms, p95 +18ms, 5xx 0.02% (no spike). report: https://perf/reports/1932109876
Sam: OK thanks. Jordan — please post both load test and a short script to replay any failing requests if we see regression.
Jordan: added replay snippet to the report and a quick k6 script:
```bash
k6 run --vus 50 --duration 10m replay-script.js
```
Sam: scheduling the 5% canary toggle at 12:00. I’ll broadcast status updates.
deploy-bot: Feature flag ff_prefetch_batching_v2 toggled ON for audience canary-5pct by Sam at 1932110400
Anya: canary looks stable after 15m. p95 delta ~+20ms, no error increase.
oncall: no alerts so far. monitoring kv_cache and p95.
Lee: set temporary alert: kv_cache_eviction_rate > baseline + 30% for 10m. If fired, we rollback.
Sam: good. if everything stays green we plan ramp to 25% at 12:30 and full enable at 13:00.
Jordan: 25% ramp done — perf still healthy (p95 +25ms). no increase in 5xx.
Anya: continuing to observe mem usage — trend looks flat.
oncall: still zero alerts. standing by until 14:00.
deploy-bot: Feature flag ff_prefetch_batching_v2 toggled ON for audience canary-25pct by Sam at 1932111000
Sam: rolling to all users at 13:00 unless objections. will post final status. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Feature flag ff_prefetch_batching_v2 toggled ON for audience all-users by Sam at 1932111600
Lee: post-mortem note for rollout doc — add kv_cache evictions and avg batch size to the continuous monitoring dashboard.
Sam: thanks team. summarize: canary, no regressions, manual guardrails + oncall ready, ramped to all. If any alert fires, rollback procedure = flip flag + notify channels.
Anya: will follow up with a short writeup for the deploy notes and attach load tests.
Jordan: posted artifacts and graphs in the report.
Sam: closing the thread — great coordination everyone.
